name: Personal: Invoice Chase (Freelancer)
description: Solo-operator starter: find unpaid invoices in your inbox, match them against your records, and draft polite reminder emails — every send passes an approval gate first. Built for Personal Edition (BYOK or fully local).
author: Atom

inputs.name: client_email_domain
inputs.label: Client email domain
inputs.description: Only chase invoices for this client domain, e.g. acmecorp.com. Leave empty to scan all.
inputs.help_text: Narrowing the scan keeps the first run small and fast.

inputs.name: overdue_days
inputs.label: Overdue after (days)
inputs.description: Consider an invoice overdue past this many days since issue.

steps.name: Scan inbox for invoice threads
steps.description: Find emails matching invoice/payment threads from the client domain.

steps.name: Extract invoice status
steps.description: Agent reads each thread and extracts invoice number, amount, issue date, and whether payment was mentioned.

steps.name: Flag overdue invoices
steps.description: Keep only unpaid invoices older than the overdue threshold.

steps.name: Draft friendly reminders
steps.description: Draft a short, polite reminder per overdue invoice referencing the invoice number and amount.

steps.name: Approve before send (HITL)
steps.description: Nothing is sent without you. Review each draft; approve sends it, edits are honored, rejects archive the draft.

steps.name: Send approved reminders
steps.description: Send only the approved reminder emails via Gmail.
